title: Pretty
text:
Pretty. These lights are cute. They look very pretty. The string is not long. It goes across the queen size headboard my daughter has. It takes two AA batteries that are not included. The battery pack looks pretty cheaply made, so I am trying to be careful to not break it. I wouldn't expect like super high quality for what I paid. They look awesome. They work. That is what I was going for.

Update: It didn't take long for all the globes to break. They fell apart along the middle. I don't even know how they were held on. Looking at them I cannot figure out how in the world they were even put together. I expected the lights to break, just not quite so quickly.
